name: KYC & Customer Due Diligence Policy
state: Policy prescribes biennial re-KYC for high-risk customers and a 25% beneficial ownership threshold.
gap: Sections 4.1, 6.3 and Annexure B carry the superseded thresholds.

name: AML / CFT Policy
state: Covers STR filing and customer risk rating; there is no CRILC exception reporting workflow.
gap: No section on KYC exception reporting or Principal Officer sign-off.

name: Data Privacy & Retention Policy
state: Retention schedule sets five years for KYC records and does not cover consent artefacts.
gap: Retention period and consent audit-trail clauses are outdated.

name: Outsourcing & Third-Party Risk Policy
state: Annual vendor reviews exist; there is no board approval step for outsourcing a regulated function.
gap: Board approval and materiality classification are missing.

name: Board Governance Charter
state: Board reviews the KYC policy annually and the Audit Committee meets half-yearly.
gap: Review cadence is below the amended requirement.

name: Digital Lending Policy
state: Permits a 5% default loss guarantee cap and a three-day cooling-off period.
gap: DLG cap and cooling-off period are below the amended requirement.

name: Cyber Security Policy
state: SOC coverage is business hours only; logs are retained for 90 days.
gap: Monitoring window and log retention fall short.

name: Retail Customer Onboarding
state: Capture, CKYC check and manual BO declaration; PAN-Aadhaar linkage is checked after account opening.
gap: Verification is post-facto and the BO cut-off is 25%.

name: Periodic KYC Review
state: Review dates are generated by a monthly batch using a 24-month high-risk cycle.
gap: Batch cycle and reminders need re-parameterisation.

name: High-Risk Customer Review
state: EDD checklist covers source of funds; there is no trigger-based risk re-rating between reviews.
gap: No event-driven review trigger.

name: Beneficial Ownership Determination
state: Ops traces shareholding to 25% using MCA filings and a manual declaration.
gap: Manual tracing and annual refresh are not defined.

name: Regulatory Reporting – CRILC
state: Monthly CRILC upload covers large credit exposures only; there is no KYC exception feed.
gap: No exception data, no seven-day SLA.

name: Records Management
state: Retention schedule is applied by record class; KYC records are destroyed after five years.
gap: Retention and retrieval SLAs are short of the amendment.

name: Account Aggregator Consent Flow
state: Consent is journey-level, is not purpose-bound and cannot be revoked in-app.
gap: Consent model does not meet purpose limitation or revocation.

name: Video KYC (V-CIP)
state: Agent-led video call; recording stored for five years; no liveness or geo-tag check.
gap: Liveness, geo-tagging and retention are non-compliant.

name: Key Fact Statement Delivery
state: KFS is generated in English only and acknowledged through a click-through in the app.
gap: No vernacular KFS and acknowledgement is not an explicit action.

name: Cooling-Off and Exit
state: Three-day cooling-off window; exit requests are handled through the grievance desk.
gap: Window is shorter than the amended requirement.

name: Vendor Onboarding & Review
state: Vendors are risk-rated annually; cyber assessment is a self-attestation questionnaire.
gap: No independent cyber assessment before onboarding.

name: Cyber Incident Response
state: Incidents are reported to the regulator within 24 hours after internal triage.
gap: Reporting SLA and RCA timeline are longer than permitted.

name: Grievance Redressal
state: Complaints are logged in CRM; there is no linkage to regulatory reporting.
gap: No regulatory tagging of complaints.

name: CIF / Core Banking System
state: Customer master stores one BO percentage field hard-coded at 25 and derives the review date from the risk tier.
gap: Schema and batch logic encode the old thresholds.

name: Digital Onboarding Portal
state: Journey calls CKYC and PAN validation APIs; Aadhaar linkage status is not checked.
gap: No PAN-Aadhaar linkage API call at journey start.

name: CKYC Registry Adapter
state: Pushes records to CERSAI CKYC and retries failed uploads for 24 hours.
gap: No change feed for re-KYC updates.

name: AML Screening Engine
state: Screens sanctions and PEP lists at onboarding and nightly; risk score is static.
gap: Risk score is not recalculated on trigger events.

name: CRILC Reporting Module
state: Generates the monthly large-credit file; there is no exception or KYC data feed.
gap: No KYC exception schema or seven-day scheduler.

name: Document Management System
state: Retention rules are configured per document class; purge job runs at five years.
gap: Retention rule and retrieval index need updating.

name: V-CIP Module
state: Records video to object storage; no liveness SDK and no geo-tag capture.
gap: Liveness and geo-tagging must be added to the capture flow.

name: Consent & Preference Hub
state: Stores consent flags per product; revocation requires a support ticket.
gap: No purpose-bound consent artefact or immutable trail.

name: Workflow & Notification Engine
state: Sends email and SMS from static templates; no regulatory task routing.
gap: No regulatory task queue or escalation.

name: Loan Management System
state: Calculates DLG exposure at 5% and enforces a three-day cooling-off flag.
gap: Hard-coded DLG cap and cooling-off window.

name: KFS Generator
state: Renders an English KFS PDF from the loan schedule; acknowledgement is a click event.
gap: Single-language template and weak acknowledgement.

name: SOC / SIEM
state: Monitors production systems during business hours; hot storage retained for 90 days.
gap: Coverage window and retention are short of the framework.

name: Vendor Risk Platform
state: Tracks vendor contracts and annual review dates; cyber questionnaire is manual.
gap: No cyber scoring or pre-onboarding gate.

name: CRM & Service Desk
state: Ticketing for complaints and service requests; no regulatory tagging.
gap: No regulatory taxonomy on cases.

name: Customer Risk Rating (CDD-01)
state: Risk rating is assigned at onboarding and refreshed annually.
gap: Trigger-based re-rating is not evidenced.

name: Beneficial Ownership Check (CDD-04)
state: Four-eyes check on the BO declaration; threshold documented as 25%.
gap: Control description and test script use the old threshold.

name: Periodic Review Scheduler (KYC-07)
state: Batch scheduler produces review tasks from the CIF review date.
gap: Scheduler parameters and exception reporting are manual.

name: Regulatory Reporting Reconciliation (RPT-03)
state: Monthly reconciliation of CRILC and other regulatory extracts.
gap: No reconciliation for KYC exceptions.

name: Retention Schedule (REC-02)
state: Record-class retention matrix approved by the Board.
gap: Matrix reflects five-year retention.

name: KFS Delivery Check (DL-01)
state: Sampling check that KFS was delivered before disbursal.
gap: Sample does not verify language or explicit acknowledgement.

name: Consent Audit (PRV-05)
state: Quarterly sample audit of consent artefacts.
gap: Audit does not test purpose limitation or revocation.
